acceptance.description: Retain full original W02 typed access/refresh separation, required claims, current human account/session revocation, restricted onboarding, conditional lifecycle/removal barriers, safe signing readiness and N14 bounded login/audit behavior; do not redo unaffected fixes or claim helper-only closure.

Shared identities with current tenant memberships/roles: tenant admins manage only their tenant membership; explicit configured stamp owners with current completed human sessions alone administer global accounts. Native atomic revision/target/payload-bound last-owner recovery is retry safe and cannot resurrect deleted identities or overwrite later changes. Global identity mutations conditionally recheck the acting owner account/session at commit, not only the target or earlier HTTP guard.

Individually registered service credentials bind ID/token hash/subject/expiry/current grants/revocation before effects. Conditional atomic issuance/replacement/revocation cannot revive retired state; machines remain independent of human sessions. Tool migration is explicit and does not silently self-mint unregistered customer authority.

Integrate trusted current authority through all direct content/decision/audit/operator consumers, exact customer route/method/upgrade controls and account UI. Two-tenant refusals precede effects. Synthetic signing A to unsafe to B rejects stale human/service tokens and recovers current legitimate users/tools without changing site keys/identity salt/accounts; onboarding remains enforced.
Distinct frozen-artifact review inspects every original W02 requirement, actual task-only deltas and primary evidence; preserve failed attempts and full operational limits.

Separately authorized deployed schema, owner/membership/credential migration, secure handoff, key rotation and real operator/tool recovery/readiness evidence for selected artifact. Required live acceptance remains open for final batch.
